statements.text: The American AI Exports Program delivers on President Trump’s directive to ensure that American AI systems – built on trusted hardware, secure data, and world-leading innovation – are deployed at scale around the world,
statements.context: Named quotation on the American AI Exports Program. Export promotion alone does not establish a position on export restrictions.

statements.text: Under the strong leadership of President Donald Trump, the Commerce Department is taking decisive action to protect America. We will not allow adversaries to exploit American technology to bolster their own militaries and threaten American lives,
statements.context: Named quotation in Commerce’s announcement of Entity List export restrictions on Chinese AI and advanced computing capabilities.

attribution.speaker: Howard Lutnick
attribution.note: Exact excerpt from the current BIS news page; the date is the release date.
